summary: Iteration 11 frontend-only regression: re-verified the AuthContext.logout() fix from iteration 10. All 5 scenarios from the review request PASSED on 390x844 viewport. (1) Splash still auto-routes to /(tabs)/dashboard directly (no /login) — confirmed. (2) Dashboard renders 'Good morning, Dr. Veterinarian' on fresh app load — confirmed. (3) BUG FIX VERIFIED: Settings → Reset Local Data → splash → dashboard renders correctly with 'Good morning, Dr. Veterinarian' and NO blank state. localStorage.current_user id changed from 24b33374-19c5-483b-a9d8-7928a410f68c (pre) to 43aefbc7-1e0f-49e8-9f30-778fa0fefbfa (post), with name='Veterinarian' and category='Doctor' — exactly matching the expected new anonymous UserProfile. (4) New Evaluation flow entry works (Dog & Owner form renders with all fields). (5) /login and /register both return Expo Router 'Unmatched Route' 404 as expected. The pre-existing cosmetic console warnings from iteration 10 (useNativeDriver, props.pointerEvents deprecated, transform-origin invalid DOM prop, Image style.resizeMode deprecated) are still present but non-blocking for the APK build.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' Cosmetic on web preview only; native driver will engage on the APK. No action required.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Cosmetic; move the prop into style. Likely in Pressable or a wrapping View.

Console error: 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' A StyleSheet somewhere sets 'transform-origin' instead of 'transformOrigin'. Cosmetic on web; rename for cleanliness.
Console warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' Move resizeMode out of style and into the Image prop.

action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup (not blocking): grep the codebase for `transform-origin` and rename to `transformOrigin`; grep for `pointerEvents=` prop usages and move them into style; move Image `resizeMode` from style to prop. All three are console-noise-only cleanups.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.tsx logout() fix looks correct: bootstrapAnon() persists the new anon user to storage AND calls setUser(anon) synchronously before Settings.tsx calls router.replace('/'). This guarantees non-null user state through the splash→dashboard transition. Verified behaviorally.

Minor: the initial-mount useEffect (lines 45-76) still parses the stored string twice (once in try/catch, once in the `cur` recomputation). Could be refactored to a single parse for cleanliness — cosmetic only.
